firmographic.name: Cloudflare
firmographic.company_description:
Cloudflare (NYSE:NET) is a public web infrastructure and cybersecurity company founded in 2009 and headquartered in San Francisco, operating a single proprietary anycast network spanning 335+ cities that reaches 95% of the world's Internet-connected population within 50ms. The platform sits in front of approximately 20% of all HTTP traffic and powers 42% of the Fortune 500, with operational scale evidenced by 234B daily cyber threats blocked. Products are sold in three integrated layers: Application Services (CDN, DNS, WAF, API Shield, DDoS Protection, Bot Management, Turnstile, Magic Transit), Cloudflare One SASE/Zero Trust (Access, Secure Web Gateway, DLP, Browser Isolation, Magic WAN, Email Security via the acquired Area 1), and a Developer Platform (Cloudflare Workers, Workers AI serving 70+ models, R2, D1, KV, Durable Objects, AI Gateway, Vectorize, AI Search, plus the VoidZero/Vite toolchain following the June 2026 acquisition).

Cloudflare makes money through a hybrid model: (i) tiered subscriptions (Free, Pro at $20/mo, Business at $200/mo, custom Enterprise contracts) for application services; (ii) per-seat SASE pricing ($7/user/month with the first 50 users free); and (iii) usage-based developer platform billing starting at $5/month. Distribution is a hybrid of self-serve PLG through the cloudflare.com storefront, direct enterprise field sales, the PowerUP Partner Program, and global system integrators. The company is a recognized leader in Forrester Wave WAF 2025 and is referenced by major media and Gartner as an authority on Internet traffic via Cloudflare Radar.

The business is at an inflection point: TTM revenue reached $2.33B at ~31.5% growth with FY2026 guidance of $2.81B (29.6% growth), but the company executed a ~20% workforce reduction in May 2026 explicitly tied to an AI-driven strategic shift. Recent moves include the acquisitions of Replicate (AI model deployment, Nov 2025), VoidZero/Vite (June 2026), and Ensemble AI talent (June 2026), the launch of Cloudflare Agents and Temporary Accounts for AI agents, the Cloudflare One Design Partner Program, and positioning as a foundational infrastructure layer for the agentic internet through partnerships with Anthropic, OpenAI, Mastercard (AP4M), Stripe, Coinbase (x402), and Okta. Post-quantum cryptography leadership (2029 PQC migration) and PACT (with Mozilla, Google, Microsoft, Shopify) extend the moat into emerging standards.

recent_move.description: Executed a ~20% workforce reduction (~1,100 layoffs) explicitly tied to an AI-driven pivot from 'measurers' to 'builders' and 'sellers,' with plans to re-hire agentic-AI-skilled talent in 2027.

Acquired VoidZero (Evan You) — Vite, Vitest, Rolldown, and Oxc JavaScript toolchain with 130M+ weekly downloads — committing $1M to an independent Vite ecosystem fund to enable one-click deployment of AI-generated code to Cloudflare Workers.
Agreed to acquire Replicate, an AI model deployment platform with 50,000+ production-ready models including OpenAI's GPT-5.1, to integrate into Cloudflare Workers as a leading AI inference substrate.
Acquired key members of Ensemble AI, bringing NdLinear/NdLinear-LoRA model compression techniques onto the Workers AI serverless GPU platform to lower LLM serving costs.

Launched the Cloudflare One Design Partner Designation with five inaugural SIs (Arctiq, Consortium, CMT, Presidio, The Missing Link) and the Cloudflare One Stack AI skills library, positioning channel partners as the primary growth engine for SASE and AI security migrations.

Launched Cloudflare Temporary Accounts for AI Agents, a 60-minute ephemeral identity system letting AI agents deploy Workers, APIs and front-ends from CLI without human signup — a foundational primitive for agentic cloud procurement.
Raised approximately $1.75 billion in a convertible note offering to fund AI infrastructure and developer platform expansion, complementing organic FCF generation.

leadership_change.title: Mark Anderson Retirement Announcement

expansion_highlight.description: Cloudflare Agents, AI Gateway, Vectorize, AI Search, Workers AI, and 70+ edge-served models represent a full-stack AI inference and agent-orchestration platform launched in 2025-2026, materially expanding the addressable market beyond traditional CDN/security.

Deep integrations with Anthropic (Claude Managed Agents on Cloudflare Environments), OpenAI (Daybreak Cyber Partner Program, Patch the Planet), Mastercard (AP4M with 30+ partners), Stripe (Projects protocol), Coinbase (x402 in production), Okta (Cross App Access), and PACT with Mozilla/Google/Microsoft/Shopify build a multi-sided AI-agent identity, payment, and protocol ecosystem.

Seven acquisitions in 2024-2026 (BastionZero, Nefeli, PartyKit, Baselime, Kivera, Outerbase, Human Native AI, Astro, Replicate, VoidZero, Ensemble AI) signal an aggressive AI/developer-platform tuck-in strategy, with $1B+ 2025 convertible proceeds funding further deals.

Cloudflare One Design Partner Designation (June 2026) introduces a funded-headcount, MDF-backed, roadmap-access tier within the PowerUP program aimed at converting the SASE/AI security migration opportunity through Global SIs and regional VADs.

Post-quantum cryptography leadership — 2029 migration commitment with Google, PACT protocol submission for standardization across ~77% of browser market, and Visionary positioning in Moody's quantum-safe rankings — positions Cloudflare for 'harvest now, decrypt later' compliance budgets.

CPU-time-based billing (not wall-clock) for Workers, the $7/user/month SASE price with 50 free users, and Pay Per Crawl marketplace for AI content monetization are pricing innovations designed to capture AI-agent and mid-market workloads that AWS/Lambda and Zscaler underserve.

Investment in Subco's SMAP submarine cable (400+ Tbit/s across Sydney-Melbourne-Perth) and continued office buildout in Bangalore R&D, Seoul, Mexico City, and Dubai support expansion into APAC, EMEA, and Latin America enterprise markets.
